notes.title: Sound Missing Files
notes.notes: 6 sound files were missing in our last updates which made pop up some errors in-game, sorry for the trouble, we have fixed them as soon as we got the reports.

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.notes: We fixed a bug that was keeping new players from starting the game, we are really sorry for the inconvenience and hope you will still play the game :D

Welcome to the RPG Maker Festival!!

We will be live during the event!

notes.title: New Languages
notes.notes:
We are adding japanese as a language available on Kamigami!
We are also working hard on our new mythology - Brazilian!

Lastly, we will be hosted in RPG Maker Festival!

notes.title: Kamigami Continues!
notes.notes:
We are working on new content and new cards! This will also effect the original game.

Kamigami: Spirits of the Nature will focus on the brazilian mythology and will have a brand new campaign mode, while we are focused on that game, we will be looking forward to make both experiences better, the online mode will be worked on for integrations between both games!

Even though Kamigami wasn't a complete success, we believe that with our hard work, more people will know and enjoy our game!

notes.title: Fixes and Balaces!
notes.notes:
- Balanced: Zeus, Hades, Set, Isis, Ra, Odin, Thor, Loki, Izanagi, Izanami, Tsukuyomi and Amaterasu

- Fixed Achievements: Tsukuyomi, Yuki-Onna, Norn

- Fixed Campaign mode, Kirin is now available in campaign also.
